<thought>Based on the observed isotopic envelope, the pattern of peaks spaced ~1.003 Da with ~8‑10 % intensity relative to the monoisotopic peak indicates the presence of carbon (13C isotopes). Additionally, a clear M+2 peak about 2 Da higher than the monoisotopic peak with ~24 % intensity matches the characteristic chlorine isotopic pattern (35Cl/37Cl). No other element shows a distinctive isotopic signature in the data. Therefore the definitively identifiable elements are carbon and chlorine.</thought>
<final_answer>['C', 'Cl']</final_answer>
